## Verdict: **ADJUST** **Files read (read-only; nothing created/modified/deleted):** - `dashboard/static/games/wipeout_v2.html` — **does not exist** (draft's path note is correct) - `dashboard/static/wipeout_v2.html` — live file (293 lines), audited - `watch/inbox/games_polish/p06-wipeout-v2.md` — draft (67 lines, **truncated mid-token at line 67**: `gl.uniform1f(U.uSeed,(f.length*7919)%10`) - Hash-checked: `site/dist/games/wipeout_v2.html` = live byte-identical (SHA256 `f90dfeb0…`); `dist_audit/nacho_business_audit_20260912T214050Z/dashboard/static/wipeout_v2.html` differs (`57b6cba9…`) — draft's path claims all verified. ### Audit verification — all claims check out - Menu promises "the drops push the rush" (:30–31) with **zero drop detection** — only `eAvg=.8/.2` smoothing (:275). ✓ - `uSeed = (f.length*7919)%1000/100` (:282) — filename length only, 4 tracks ⇒ 4 fixed seeds; "song hash" claim false. ✓ - HUD `SPEED` (:284) `2*(1+eAvg*3)` omits BPM; true world rate is `2*(uBPM/60)*(1+uEnergy*.8)` units/s (:170–171, :176). ✓ - `#end`/`#estats` (:45) referenced by no JS; `srcNode.loop=true` (:260). ✓ - No `keydown` listener anywhere (grep: zero matches); HUD :43 advertises ←/→. ✓ `onclick=null` (:249) one-shot. ✓ ### Why ADJUST (4 defects in the draft) 1. **Draft is truncated** — insertion 7's code block ends mid-literal at line 67; SPEED replacement and `uRush` upload never delivered. Not applicable as written. 2. **Insertion 2 (`speed *= 1.+uRush*.45;` after :176) is broken.** `speed` is an **absolute z-offset**, not a rate — `ro.z += speed` (:178), `tp.z -= speed` (:148), and `speed = 2*(uBPM*iTime/60)*(1+uEnergy*.8)` grows linearly with elapsed time. On drop attack `rush` jumps 0→1 in one frame ⇒ **instant teleport of 0.45×speed** (~100+ units mid-song, unbounded as the loop runs); on decay (`rush*.98` ≈ 1.5–3 s) the whole world **slides backwards** below base rate. Fix: warp the song clock in JS instead (iTime is used at exactly one place, :170 — verified by grep), so `dT/dt = 1+.45*rush` — continuous, never rewinds, and makes "the drops push the rush" literally true at the clock. 3. **`#rush` badge opacity and the SPEED rewrite are never wired** — would ship dead HTML, the exact disease the audit diagnosed in `#end`. 4. **Anchor off-by-one:** `uniform float uSeed;` is line **70**, not 71 (line 71 is `out vec4 fragColor;`). **Audio coupling:** preserved and strengthened — BPM→clock, RMS→speed, bass→amber, and new drop→rush all feed from the same analyser/BPM pipeline. Nothing decoupled. --- ### FINAL CODE — 7 sites, exact anchors (live file `dashboard/static/wipeout_v2.html`) **S1 — GLSL uniform. After :70, before :71:** ```glsl uniform float uSeed; // song hash — each song is a different world uniform float uRush; // detected drop window — the rush the menu promises out vec4 fragColor; ``` **S2 — RELOCATED (replaces draft insertion 2; no shader-side `speed*=…`).** Rush couples through the clock upload in S7-edit-C below. Anchor stays untouched: ```glsl speed*=2.; ro=vec3(0.,0.1,-.5-trnd.x),rt=vec3(0); ``` **S3 — FOV kick. Replace :183 exactly:** ```glsl // OLD: rd = (o=mat3(x,cross(z,x),z))*normalize(rs=vec3(uv,.5-mix(.4,.1,trnd.x+rnd.y*.03))); rd = (o=mat3(x,cross(z,x),z))*normalize(rs=vec3(uv*(1.-uRush*.15),.5-mix(.4,.1,trnd.x+rnd.y*.03))); ``` **S4 — Amber surge.
